audience: Accountants and sales staff who sell a fixed asset to a customer and need the asset removed from the books.
goal: **Sell a fixed asset**: raise a **sales order** to the customer, **confirm** it and **invoice** it, then open the asset, use **Modify Depreciation › Sell**, **link the customer invoice**, and **post** the disposal entry so that the asset is **Closed** with a book value of zero.
before: The asset you are selling exists and is **Running** (see the *Create Fixed Asset* guide).
The customer exists (the guide uses **AC005851, Mr Kolitha Thushara**).
You know the sale price and the product that represents the sale on the order.
outcome: A customer **sales order** is confirmed and a customer **invoice** is **Posted**.
The disposal journal entry is **Posted**, with the asset removed (credit), the depreciation to date and the sale (income).
The asset is **Closed** and its **Book Value** is **0**.
notes: The screenshots were captured by an automated run on a **test database**. The red banner at the top ("Database neutralized for testing") only appears on test databases. The asset name carries a `[TEST]` tag and a random code, and the amounts (100,000.00) are test data.

The automated run **creates its own running asset first** and then sells it, so every run is self-contained. Posted entries cannot be deleted, so each run leaves a closed `[TEST]` asset, a sales order and an invoice behind.

**Confirming the order needs analytic accounts.** This database requires the analytic plans **Sales Center** and **Product Group** to map to an account, using the order's **warehouse** and the product's **category**. The tour's *Production Warehouse (PW-JM)* has no Sales Center account here, so the run uses a warehouse and a product that do (the screenshots show them). If Odoo says *the following required analytic plan(s) have no matching account*, change the warehouse or product.
The product must be invoiced on **ordered quantities**. Otherwise Odoo says *No items are available to invoice* until the goods are delivered.
The **Gain Account** in the Sell window is required and was empty on this database, so the run picks the account Odoo offers. Choose the account your accountant uses for the gain or loss on disposal.

phases.title: Create and confirm the sales order
phases.summary: Raise the quotation, set the customer, type and warehouse, add the product and confirm.
phases.checkpoint: The quotation is now a **Sales Order**.

phases.title: Invoice the customer
phases.summary: Create the invoice from the order and confirm it.
phases.checkpoint: The customer invoice is **Posted** and has a number.

phases.title: Sell the asset
phases.summary: Open the asset, choose Sell, link the invoice and post the disposal entry.
phases.checkpoint: The disposal entry is **Posted** and the asset is **Closed** with a book value of **0**.

glossary.meaning: A confirmed quotation: the customer's agreement to buy at the stated price.
The button on a running asset that lets you dispose of, sell, re-evaluate or pause it.
**Dispose** scraps the asset with no income. **Sell** links a customer invoice and books the sale.
The journal entry that removes the asset, depreciates it up to the sale date and books the sale.
The account that takes any gain or loss between the sale price and the asset's book value.
The asset's original value minus depreciation to date. It is 0 once the asset is closed.
A way to tag a line (here **Sales Center** and **Product Group**) for management reporting. Some plans are required before an order can be confirmed.

1.title: Create a new quotation
1.why: Selling an asset starts like any other sale: with a quotation to the customer.

2.title: Select the customer
2.do: Type the customer code and pick the customer from the list.
actions: Click **Mr Kolitha Thushara** in the list.
2.see: The customer's name and address appear.
2.why: The invoice and the sale of the asset are linked to this customer.

3.title: Set the quotation type to Sales
3.why: The type decides how the order is processed.

4.title: Open the Other Info tab
actions: Look at the tabs under the form.
4.why: The delivery warehouse is set here.

5.title: Open the Warehouse field
5.see: The field is ready for typing.
5.why: The warehouse must match the order's company.

6.title: Set the warehouse
6.do: Choose the warehouse for the order.
actions: Type the start of the warehouse name.
Click the warehouse in the list.

enter.value: a warehouse of the order's company

6.why: The warehouse also decides the analytic **Sales Center** of the order.
6.warning: If Odoo later refuses to confirm the order because an analytic plan has no matching account, choose a warehouse that has a Sales Center account.

7.title: Open the Order Lines tab
7.see: The order lines with **Add a product**.
7.why: You add what you are selling here.

8.title: Add a product
8.do: Click **Add a product**, choose the product and enter the price.
actions: Pick the product that represents the sale.
Type the sale price as the **Unit Price**, for example **100000**.
8.see: One order line with the price you typed.
8.why: The price on this line is what the customer is invoiced and what the asset is sold for.
8.warning: The product must be invoiced on **ordered quantities**; otherwise Odoo says there is nothing to invoice until the goods are delivered.

9.title: Confirm the quotation
9.why: The quotation becomes a Sales Order.
9.warning: If Odoo says *Cannot create sale order line… analytic plans have no matching account*, the warehouse or product has no Sales Center or Product Group account.

10.title: Create the invoice
actions: If a window opens, click **Create Draft Invoice**.
10.see: A **draft** customer invoice for the order.
10.why: The invoice is what you link to the asset sale.

11.title: Confirm the invoice
11.do: Click **Confirm** to post the customer invoice.
11.see: The status moves to **Posted** and the invoice has a number.
11.why: Only a posted invoice can be linked to the asset sale.

12.title: Modify Depreciation
12.do: Open the asset and click **Modify Depreciation**.
12.where: Accounting > Management > Assets > asset > Modify Depreciation
actions: Open **Accounting › Assets** and the asset you are selling.
12.why: This opens the disposal and sale window.

13.title: Select Sell
13.see: **Sell** is selected, and a **Customer Invoice** field appears.
13.why: **Dispose** scraps the asset with no income. **Sell** books the sale against an invoice.

14.title: Link the customer invoice
14.do: Type the invoice number and select it. Then choose the **Gain Account**.
actions: Type the invoice number and click it.
Check that the **Invoice Line** fills in.

enter.value: the account for gain or loss on disposal

14.see: The invoice and its line appear as tags. Once the Gain Account is chosen, the window can run.
14.why: The sale price comes from the invoice line, and the Gain Account takes the difference from the asset's book value.
14.warning: The **Gain Account** is required. If **Sell** does nothing, check that it is filled in.

15.title: Sell
actions: Click **Sell** at the bottom of the window.
15.why: Odoo creates the entry: it removes the asset, depreciates it to the sale date and books the sale.
15.tip: Read the entry before you post it.

16.title: Post the disposal entry
16.see: The entry is **Posted** and gets a number.
16.warning: A posted entry cannot be deleted. Use **Reverse Entry** if you must undo it.

17.title: Check the asset is closed
17.do: Click the **Asset** button to confirm the asset is **Closed** with a book value of **0**.
actions: Click the **Asset** button at the top.
17.see: The status is **Closed** and the **Book Value** is **0.0000**. The chatter shows *Asset sold*.
17.why: This confirms the sale is complete.
17.tip: That completes the tour: sales order, invoice, and the asset sold and closed.
